facts.value: English Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt
Study and research in the heart of Europe! As an international university with an excellent reputation, Goethe University offers a wide range of opportunities.
All important information regarding your path to studying with us has been summarized: from admission requirements to application and language skills.
The Global Office assists international exchange and scholarship students during their study stay at Goethe University - from preparation to personal support on-site in Frankfurt.
The Goethe Welcome Centre has gathered important information and services for international postdoctoral researchers, doctoral candidates, and professors at Goethe University.
From initial consulting to a buddy program: Goethe University offers services regarding study applications, scholarships, residence rights, and much more - for a successful start in Frankfurt.
Need assistance for your career start? The International Career Service Rhein-Main helps you successfully navigate the path from study to work in the German job market.

Goethe University supports refugees before, during, and after their studies. In addition to preparatory and language courses, the offer includes scholarships, assistance with housing, bureaucratic processes, financing, and integration.
Discover the language offerings and opportunities for study preparation for foreign applicants at Goethe University.
